line: English Christian everyday-faith story, animated, narrated

validation.rule: SYSTEM.md 1.5: >=6 winners from >=4 channels, no channel > 1/3, >=3 weak contrasts, drivers counted
missing: 5 more audited adult-audience winners from >=3 more channels

conflict_check.policy: no risk found: original characters, original story, public-domain Scripture, synthetic voice disclosed
conflict_check.coherence: a story format beside guided prayer; the channel stays 'everyday faith'

character_animation.value: real body and face animation, >=24 unique fps
character_animation.label: hypothesis (1/1 adult winner); also an authenticity requirement (not a slideshow)

hook.value: one continuous establishing shot with a character in need within 10 s
hook.label: hypothesis (1/1)

arc.value: need -> hesitation -> act of kindness -> quiet consequence -> one-line meaning
arc.label: hypothesis

camera.value: wide/medium/close alternation, slow dolly and track
camera.label: hypothesis (1/1)

voice.value: spoken narrator (house choice); the adult winner is sung
voice.label: free

on_screen_text.value: only the Scripture card and the final CTA card
on_screen_text.label: house choice (winner: none)

shorts.value: 2 Shorts of ~41-42 s from the master's own spans at speed 1.0, native 9:16
shorts.label: owner's test spec
